candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with setting owner to the zero address (address(0)), changing owner after owned() to the zero address instead of msg.sender.
Replace assignment to owner with assigning owner to tx.origin, changing owner after owned() to the transaction originator instead of msg.sender.
Replace assignment to owner with assigning owner to a fixed hardcoded address, making owner equal to that constant after owned().
Replace assignment to owner with assigning owner to tx.origin while preserving payable cast (alternative variation), changing owner to tx.origin.
Change the onlyOwner modifier's require to check that msg.sender != owner (inverting the condition), so owned() can set owner when caller is not current owner.
Modify burn so it subtracts from totalSupply a different amount (double the requested _value), changing totalSupply after burn.
Modify burn so it does not decrease totalSupply at all (remove the totalSupply decrement), leaving totalSupply unchanged after burn.

Change onlyOwner modifier to assign owner to msg.sender when called (so calling onlyOwner will change owner), potentially allowing non-owners to pass owner checks after it's invoked, affecting who can call burn and thus totalSupply changes.
Modify burn so it erroneously increases totalSupply instead of decreasing it.
